resources.string: OpenCMR2 plays your copy of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 for PC. Copy its installation folder to this device, then choose it here. The game files are copied into the app, about 700 MB, only once.

Choose the folder where the PC game is installed, or a folder that contains it. Copy the whole installation folder to the device, not only some files. Files on a CD or ISO need to be installed or extracted first.
No game installation was found in this folder. Choose the folder where the PC game is installed.
This folder has only part of the game installation. Copy the whole installation folder of the PC game to the device, not only some files, and choose it again.
The game files in the app are incomplete, so the game cannot start. Copy the whole installation folder of the PC game to the device and choose it again.
More than one game installation was found in this folder:\n%1$s\nChoose the one you want to use.
Not enough free space: the game needs %1$s and %2$s are free.
The game files could not be copied.\n%1$s
No file manager opened the folder. Open the Files app and choose OpenCMR2 in its menu.
Controllers are detected automatically. Test yours here, or tap a control to correct its mapping. Changes are saved for this device; other controls keep their automatic mapping.
Connect a controller to test or configure it. You can always use touch controls in the game.
Press buttons or move a stick to test input.
Move the stick in the direction shown. Use the touchscreen to cancel.
Press and release a button, move the D-pad, or press a trigger. Use the touchscreen to cancel.
Key %1$d is not supported by SDL. Try another controller mode in your device settings.
Use touch controls instead of a controller
Press and hold several buttons to test them. No input is sent to the game.
Drag either side to move its controls. Pinch to resize; twist to rotate auxiliary buttons.
